timingMethod.coldCache: new browser context, empty application/query cache
timingMethod.warmCache: same context after one complete synchronization

initialMarketDepth.readyDefinition: all configured market aggregate reads complete

typicalColdBorrowRoute.readyDefinition: scope complete, same-block conservation passes, selected candidates are hydrated

firstVerifiedPortfolioRow.readyDefinition: one discovered row has direct ownership/contribution and state verification

claimAllDiscoveredPlan.readyDefinition: both independent candidate sets agree at one block/hash and action-critical hydration is complete

providerProfile.tier: Alchemy PAYG or provider-equivalent historical tier
providerProfile.transportIdentityEvidence: provider name plus SHA-256 of origin; never a full RPC URL
providerProfile.anchor: verified fresh-generation factory deployment block/hash from the candidate artifact

currentPonderBaseline.reason: The current implementation caps global enumeration at 500 and Claim All uses one uncorroborated Ponder projection, so none of the four tasks can produce the complete ready state defined above. Recording a p95 to a false-ready state would be misleading.

validHistoryChurn.stopDecision: If the least-cost valid history that pushes any constrained-mobile first-client task past its ceiling costs less than 10 ETH at 10 gwei over 90 days, stop scanner implementation and require an economic floor or architecture revision. Browser persistence is not mitigation.
